title: Impact of Emissions Standard Announcement on Auto Maker Stock Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy  
Method: Event‐study analysis using abnormal stock returns (market‐model).  
Why: We have a single, well-defined event date (announcement = event_day 0) and high-frequency return data around it. An event study isolates the causal impact of that announcement on the firm’s valuation by comparing realized returns to a model-based “normal-return” benchmark estimated from a pre-event window.

Key assumptions  
• Market efficiency: Prices incorporate all other information quickly, so any abnormal return in a narrow window around day 0 is attributable to the announcement.  
• No confounding events during the estimation or event windows.  
• Stationary return-generating process: α and β estimated in the pre-event period remain valid during the event window.  

## 2. R Code
```r
############################################################
# Impact of Emissions-Standard Announcement on CAR’s Return
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read data
# 2. Estimate normal returns (market model) using days –30 to –6
# 3. Compute abnormal returns (AR)
# 4. Obtain cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) for several windows
# 5. Test significance
# 6. Simple robustness checks:
#    - Alternative window ([-5,+5])
#    - Mean-adjusted returns instead of market model
############################################################

library(data.table)
library(broom)

# 1. Read the CSV ------------------------------------------------------------
dat <- fread("experiments/exp_b/data/s65_data.csv")

# 2. Define estimation and event windows ------------------------------------
est_window  <- dat[event_day >= -30 & event_day <= -6]
event_win1  <- dat[event_day >= -1  & event_day <=  1]   # (-1,+1)
event_win2  <- dat[event_day >= -5  & event_day <=  5]   # (-5,+5)

# 3. Estimate market model parameters on the estimation window --------------
mm_fit <- lm(ret ~ mkt_ret, data = est_window)
alpha  <- coef(mm_fit)[1]
beta   <- coef(mm_fit)[2]

# 4. Compute abnormal returns (AR) for ALL days -----------------------------
dat[, ar := ret - (alpha + beta * mkt_ret)]

# 5. CAR calculations --------------------------------------------------------
car_1 <- dat[event_day %in% -1:1,  sum(ar)]          # 3-day CAR
car_2 <- dat[event_day %in% -5:5,  sum(ar)]          # 11-day CAR

# 6. Significance tests (t-test against 0) -----------------------------------
t_1 <- with(dat[event_day %in% -1:1],  t.test(ar))
t_2 <- with(dat[event_day %in% -5:5],  t.test(ar))

# 7. Robustness: mean-adjusted approach --------------------------------------
mean_ret_est <- mean(est_window$ret)
dat[, ar_mean := ret - mean_ret_est]
car_mean_1 <- dat[event_day %in% -1:1, sum(ar_mean)]
t_mean_1   <- with(dat[event_day %in% -1:1], t.test(ar_mean))

# 8. Print concise results ---------------------------------------------------
cat("=== Market-model results ===\n")
cat("Alpha (estimation window):", round(alpha,6), "\n")
cat("Beta  (estimation window):", round(beta ,4), "\n\n")

cat("3-day CAR (-1,+1):",  round(car_1*100,2), "%\n")
cat("   t-stat:", round(t_1$statistic,3), "  p-value:", round(t_1$p.value,4), "\n\n")

cat("11-day CAR (-5,+5):", round(car_2*100,2), "%\n")
cat("   t-stat:", round(t_2$statistic,3), "  p-value:", round(t_2$p.value,4), "\n\n")

cat("=== Robustness: Mean-adjusted returns ===\n")
cat("3-day CAR (-1,+1):",  round(car_mean_1*100,2), "%\n")
cat("   t-stat:", round(t_mean_1$statistic,3), "  p-value:", round(t_mean_1$p.value,4), "\n")

# Optional additional diagnostic output
#print(glance(mm_fit))
```

## 3. Expected Findings  
Economic logic suggests stricter emissions standards raise compliance costs for auto makers, hurting profits. Hence we expect negative abnormal performance.  
Magnitude: roughly –1 % to –2 % cumulative abnormal return over the (-1,+1) window, statistically significant at conventional levels.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Analyze stock returns before and after the announcement to isolate the impact of the emissions standard announcement.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The announcement of the new emissions standard positively affects CAR's stock returns.
